                grid[r][c], grid[r][c+1], grid[r][c+2],
                grid[r+1][c], grid[r+1][c+2],
                grid[r+2][c], grid[r+2][c+1]
            ]
            center = grid[r+1][c+1]
            
            if len(set(perimeter)) == 1 and perimeter[0] != center:
                for dr in range(3):
                    for dc in range(3):
                        result[r+dr][c+dc] = 3
    return result
